item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 30/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine weather to southern China in the next few days, but showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be windier over the coast of Guangdong early next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will reach southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Koinu will move towards the vicinity of Luzon to Taiwan early to midweek next week. However, there are uncertainties in its subsequent movement and intensity.
